name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF
objective: Tracks the CRSP US Total Market Index: large, mid and small-cap US stocks in one fund. Core diversified US equity growth holding.
risk_disclosure: Full exposure to US stock market declines. Broadly diversified across sectors and company sizes.

name: Vanguard Total International Stock ETF
objective: Tracks developed and emerging market stocks outside the US. Adds international diversification to a US-heavy equity portfolio and reduces single-position concentration.
risk_disclosure: Currency risk, foreign market risk and emerging market political risk.

name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
objective: Tracks the S&P 500 Index of 500 leading large-cap US companies. Diversified core equity growth exposure.
risk_disclosure: Equity market risk; large-cap technology makes up a significant share of the index.

name: Invesco QQQ Trust
objective: Tracks the Nasdaq-100: large non-financial technology and growth companies. Aggressive growth exposure.
risk_disclosure: High volatility and heavy technology sector concentration above 50%; growth valuation risk.

name: Vanguard High Dividend Yield ETF
objective: Holds US companies that pay above-average dividends. Suited to income-focused investors and retirees who want steady dividend income with equity growth.
risk_disclosure: Value-stock underperformance, dividend cuts and standard equity market risk.

name: Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF
objective: Tracks high-quality US dividend payers screened for cash flow and dividend growth. Dividend income with quality tilt.
risk_disclosure: Sector tilts toward financials, energy and consumer staples; equity market risk.

name: Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF
objective: Holds US companies with a record of growing dividends for at least ten years. Lower-volatility equity growth and rising income.
risk_disclosure: May lag in strong growth-led markets; equity market risk.

name: Vanguard ESG U.S. Stock ETF
objective: Broad US stock exposure screened for environmental, social and governance criteria. Sustainable responsible diversified equity.
risk_disclosure: Screening excludes some sectors, so returns can differ from the broad market.

name: Vanguard Total World Stock ETF
objective: Single fund holding of global US and international stocks. Maximum equity diversification across countries.
risk_disclosure: Global equity market risk and currency risk.

name: Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF
objective: Tracks investment-grade taxable US bonds: Treasuries, corporates and mortgage-backed. Core fixed income stability and steady interest income.
risk_disclosure: Interest rate risk (prices fall when rates rise) and modest credit risk.

name: iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF
objective: Tracks the Bloomberg US Aggregate Bond Index. Broad investment-grade fixed income bonds for stability and income.
risk_disclosure: Interest rate risk, mortgage prepayment risk and inflation risk.

name: iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF
objective: Short-term US Treasury bonds maturing in one to three years. Capital preservation for near-term goals like a home purchase or tuition.
risk_disclosure: Very low credit risk; small interest rate sensitivity; yield may trail inflation.

name: iShares 7-10 Year Treasury Bond ETF
objective: Intermediate-term US Treasury bonds. Defensive recession hedge when the yield curve is inverted.
risk_disclosure: Backed by the US government but sensitive to interest rate increases.

name: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF
objective: Long-term US Treasury bonds. Strong defensive hedge in equity sell-offs and falling rate environments.
risk_disclosure: Very high interest rate sensitivity; can lose 20%+ when long rates rise.

name: iShares TIPS Bond ETF
objective: US Treasury inflation-protected securities. Protects retiree purchasing power against inflation.
risk_disclosure: Real interest rate risk; returns lag nominal bonds when inflation is low.

name: iShares iBoxx $ Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF
objective: Investment-grade US corporate bonds. Higher income than Treasuries for steady bond income.
risk_disclosure: Corporate credit downgrade and default risk; interest rate risk.

name: iShares National Muni Bond ETF
objective: Investment-grade US municipal bonds whose income is generally free from federal tax. Tax-efficient income for high earners in taxable accounts.
risk_disclosure: Municipal credit risk and interest rate risk.

name: Vanguard Total International Bond ETF
objective: Currency-hedged investment-grade bonds issued outside the US. Diversifies fixed income across countries.
risk_disclosure: Foreign interest rate and credit risk; hedging costs.

name: Vanguard Federal Money Market Fund
objective: Short-term US government securities with a stable $1.00 share price. Cash reserve, emergency fund and liquidity safety buffer.
risk_disclosure: Extremely low risk, but yields may not keep pace with inflation.

name: iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF
objective: Treasury bills maturing within three months. Cash equivalent for liquidity, a home down payment or short-term savings with a high yield.
risk_disclosure: Virtually no credit risk; yield falls quickly when the Fed cuts short-term rates.

name: SPDR Bloomberg 1-3 Month T-Bill ETF
objective: US Treasury bills maturing in one to three months. Cash management and liquidity.
risk_disclosure: Virtually zero credit risk; sensitive to changes in short-term rates.

name: Vanguard Real Estate ETF
objective: US real estate investment trusts (REITs). Property exposure and real estate income.
risk_disclosure: Sensitive to property cycles, interest rate hikes and economic downturns.

name: SPDR Gold Shares
objective: Tracks the spot price of gold bullion. Alternative inflation and crisis hedge.
risk_disclosure: Commodity price risk; pays no yield or dividends.

name: iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF
objective: Tracks the price of bitcoin. Speculative digital asset crypto exposure.
risk_disclosure: Extreme volatility; drawdowns of 50%+ have occurred; regulatory risk.
